notes: Incremental stories added for FEAT-5 covering schema, core dispatch, integration, and testing.

change_log.value: Add tool schema/contract definition and registration mapping
Implement core tool dispatch execution pipeline
Integrate tool router with FastAPI agent loop
Add unit and integration tests for tool routing and validation

FEAT-5-S104.title: Tool Schema Contracts and Allowlist Registry
FEAT-5-S104.description: Define and register all allowable tools with strict Pydantic schemas, including input validation contracts and mapping to callable services within the tool router.

FEAT-5-S105.title: Core Tool Dispatch Execution Pipeline
FEAT-5-S105.description: Implement the end-to-end execution pipeline for tool routing including tool selection, schema validation, service invocation, and response capture within the allowlist constraints.

FEAT-5-S106.title: FastAPI Agent Loop Integration with Tool Router
FEAT-5-S106.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI main agent loop, ensuring Anthropic tool_use blocks are correctly parsed and dispatched through the allowlist routing mechanism.

FEAT-5-S107.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Routing
FEAT-5-S107.description: Develop comprehensive tests validating allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, successful dispatch, and error handling across the tool routing pipeline.
